caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, geometric structure resembling an hourglass shape composed of two cone-like forms joined at their tips, with the central area formed by radial segments creating a circular, fan-like appearance. The structure is predominantly rendered in shades of gray and is centered on a plain, off-white background. There is a single small, circular hole near the top of the structure. At the base, resting on a thin, dark horizontal line that suggests a surface or tabletop, there is a partially melted candle depicted in pale yellow and white tones; the candle has an irregular shape with visible wax drips and a short, curved black wick. The artist's signature and the location "Maria G. Chaplin - Taos, N. M." appear in the bottom right corner.
title: Tin Sconce
